items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: he'd say I want it, Sarah, bring in the contracts.

ctx.x: Tempo. The tempo out there was very slow, too slow for me, so I had a piece of material that I wanted to sell and I was in New York, I'd go up to a publisher and I'd say, here's a thing I just wrote, and he'd say play it. I'd play and he'd say I want it, Sarah, bring in the contracts. I'd sign, my advance check and that's it. Or no, I don't like it, or it's nice but I can't use it; I had my answer then.

In Hollywood it was different. I'd go to the publisher, I'd say I have a song, he'd say great, I'll tell you what, this is January 10, meet me on the golf course July 15 at three o'clock and we'll kick it around.
